title: The bird on the hood
logline: Two weeks after 'Hm': the Legacy's hood up again, Gully under it from behind, and the bird on the raised hood's edge looking down into the engine with him. He doesn't look up. He never looks at it.

panels.composition: A station wagon with its hood up in a gravel lot, a heavy gray man bent under it from behind, the small rainbow bird perched on the raised hood's edge looking down into the engine.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a faded green station wagon with its hood raised in a gravel lot, a heavy gray-haired man bent under it seen from behind and a small rainbow bird perched on the raised hood's edge looking down into the engine, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
